_meta.description: Slug Start / Fall Welcome Week 2026 events for the events recommendation agent.
_meta.verified_flag_contract: verified=true means the event's EXISTENCE and DATE were confirmed against the official UCSC page cited in `source`. It does NOT mean the time or exact location is confirmed — unpublished times are null and must never be invented. verified=false means the record is CURATED PLACEHOLDER DATA created to exercise the agent; the agent MUST label it as unofficial in every response.
_meta.times_note: The official page publishes dates but not times. Every verified event therefore has time=null. The agent renders this as 'time not yet published', never as a guess.
_meta.college_note: The official page states first-day programming depends on college affiliation, so college-specific schedules are not published centrally. college_scope='all' means all-campus.
_meta.official_disclaimer: Always confirm against the official UCSC Slug Start page and your college's own communications.

events.title: New Admit Class Photo
events.description: The whole incoming class gathers on East Upper Field for the official class photo, with Monterey Bay behind you. A UCSC tradition and the single best photo you'll get all year.

events.title: Late Night at Athletics & Rec
events.description: The recreation complex stays open late for new students — courts, pool, and games. Low-pressure way to meet people on your first night.

events.title: Cornucopia
events.description: The big campus festival where student organizations, departments, and campus services all set up tables. This is the highest-density place to find clubs to join.

events.title: Student Employment & Work-Study Fair
events.description: Campus employers and work-study programs recruiting student staff for the year. Bring your class schedule; many roles are filled on the spot.

events.title: Boardwalk Frolic
events.description: The Boardwalk is reserved for new UCSC students — free rides and games. A long-standing highlight of Welcome Week. Take the bus; do not try to walk it from campus.

events.title: Choose Your Own Slugventure
events.description: A menu of guided outings — beach trips, downtown walks, and outdoor excursions — that you pick from. Sign-ups typically fill quickly.

events.title: College Move-In Socials
events.description: Each college runs its own welcome gathering for new residents on move-in day. Times and locations come from your college, not from a central schedule.

events.title: Guided Campus Walking Tours
events.description: Student-led walking tours covering the core campus, the libraries, and Science Hill. Useful if the hills still confuse you.

events.title: Transfer Student Mixer
events.description: A gathering aimed at transfer students, who often miss the first-year programming.

events.title: Science Hill Open Labs
events.description: Research labs open their doors to incoming students. Good for anyone considering a STEM major.

events.title: Finding Things in McHenry: A Library Intro
events.description: A short session on how the library system actually works, including course reserves and study space booking.

events.title: Porter Arts Night
events.description: Open studios, student performances, and live music at Porter, UCSC's arts college.

events.title: Wellness Morning: Yoga on the Meadow
events.description: Outdoor yoga and stretching with views over the bay. Mats provided, no experience needed.

events.title: Club Sign-Up Drop-In
events.location_note: Quarry Plaza, near the Bay Tree Bookstore
events.description: A quieter follow-up to Cornucopia for students who missed it or want to talk to specific organizations.

events.title: Cultural Organizations Showcase
events.description: Performances and tabling from cultural and identity-based student organizations.

events.title: Upper Campus Welcome Dinner
events.description: A shared welcome dinner for the four upper-campus colleges.

events.title: Intramural Sports Sign-Ups
events.description: Rosters open for intramural leagues. You can sign up as a free agent if you don't have a team.

events.title: UCSC Farm & Garden Tour
events.description: Tour of the working farm run by the Center for Agroecology, with information about student apprenticeships.

events.title: Open Mic at the Quarry Amphitheater
events.description: Sign-up open mic in the stone amphitheater. Bring an instrument or just come listen.

events.title: Downtown Santa Cruz Discovery Walk
events.location_note: Meets at the Downtown Metro Center
events.description: Guided walk through downtown covering the bookshop, the farmers market area, and cheap food near Pacific Avenue.

events.title: Intro to Tech Clubs & Hackathons
events.description: Overview of the campus tech scene: hackathons, robotics, game dev, and the CS student organizations.

events.title: Beach Bonfire & Stargazing
events.description: Evening bonfire on the beach to close out the week. Bring a jacket — the coast gets cold fast after sunset.
